service_boundary: Represents DeepInfra-hosted APIs and deployments, not model publishers, client libraries, or customer-operated copies of the same weights.
regional_controls: The reviewed serverless documentation does not establish customer-selected regions for every model; dedicated deployment placement requires plan-specific review.
retention_controls: Data handling follows DeepInfra's terms and privacy documentation; dedicated and serverless logging behavior should be verified separately.
routing: Customers select a DeepInfra-hosted model or endpoint rather than upstream inference providers.
customization: Dedicated deployments and custom model hosting are available for supported artifacts.
strengths: A broad open-model catalog is available through compatible and task-specific APIs.
Serverless and dedicated paths address different capacity needs.
tradeoffs: Catalog lifecycle follows upstream model availability.
Enterprise regional and retention controls require plan-specific confirmation.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.

upstream_disclosure.note: The data-privacy page names the third parties that receive content for partner models: "If you opt to use a Google model, Google will store the output as outlined in their Privacy Notice. ... If you opt to use an Anthropic model, Anthropic will store the output as outlined in their Trust Center." The operator serves the open-weight catalogue itself.

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: "DeepInfra supports two authentication methods: API keys — full-access tokens for your own use Scoped JWTs — short-lived, scope-limited tokens you can issue to third parties".

cache_isolation.note: The prompt-caching page states: "Caches are per-model and per-account".

vulnerability_disclosure.note: No security contact or disclosure policy appears in the terms or the documentation, no security.txt is served, and the trust portal refuses automated fetches.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: DeepInfra terms of service, for DeepInfra

independent_audit.note: The operator's funding announcement names the service: "150+ open-source models through OpenAI-compatible APIs, zero data retention, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified — production-grade from day one." The trust portal holding the reports refuses automated fetches.
independent_audit.scope: DeepInfra Series B announcement, for DeepInfra

findings.claim: In 7 of these providers, we detected global cache sharing. The audit table records caching detected at the global level for Deep Infra's Llama 3.1 8B Instruct endpoint; the audits were conducted in September and early October 2024 and disclosed to each provider in October 2024.

source.label: Auditing Prompt Caching in Language Model APIs, arXiv 2502.07776v2

resolved.summary: The current prompt-caching page states caches are per-model and per-account; the paper does not name DeepInfra among the providers that confirmed a change.
